text:
mira: heads-up — onboarding saturn-11b-int4 to canary pool. Seeing coldstart OOMs + memory fragmentation spikes on p3s. anyone digging in?
aj: yup saw it this morning, ~2x OOM rate vs baseline. stack shows kv_alloc failure when handling long max_new_tokens (1024) requests.
samir: are we using windowed batching or continuous for the canary?
mira: continuous batching with prefetch=on. profile: int4 quant, no bf16, default max_new_tokens=1024.
oliver: quick thought — reduce default max_new_tokens to 512 for saturn; long tails are killing KV reserve. also consider soft cap at token-gateway so clients get a friendly error / truncation.
jess: :thumbsup: and try kv_trim_threshold=0.6 + reserve_slots=2 to reduce fragmentation during cold mem alloc.
aj: pushing a small canary change now, snippet i'm applying: 
```
model_profile: 
  name: saturn-11b-int4
  defaults:
    max_new_tokens: 512
    prefetch: true
    kv_trim_threshold: 0.6
    reserve_slots: 2
    batch_size_limit: 8
```
ci-bot: Deploy: canary config updated by aj (CI-1234) — rollout started to 10% nodes.
samir: quick run results: OOMs down ~70% on the canary. latency tail (p95) up ~12% for long-context requests — looks like extra fetches and smaller batches.
mira: that tradeoff is expected. we should try adaptive-windowing: allow larger batch if all requests have short prefixes, shrink for long ones. also add per-route override so chat endpoints keep 512 but summarization can request 1024 with tighter limits.
oliver: i'll run an experiment with reserve_slots=3, kv_trim_threshold=0.55, and explicit batch_size_cap=6 for long-context routes. running in purple-run.
jess: if that stabilizes OOMs and keeps p95 within SLO, we'll bake into model_profile and add to the regression suite.
mira: i'll create prompt-set evals hitting 800-1200 token continuations to guard against regressions. also logging note: watch for "kv_alloc: out_of_memory" lines and high slab-fragmentation metric (slab_frag_ratio>0.25).
aj: logged — saved OOM traces to s3://redwood-canary/saturn11b/trace-1769999000.log. sharing sample: 
```
[2026-03-19T14:05:12Z] kv_alloc: out_of_memory: need=48MB free=12MB
[2026-03-19T14:05:12Z] model=Saturn-11B-int4 request_id=abc123 max_new_tokens=1024 prefix_tokens=860
```
mira: perfect — thanks. next steps: oliver runs reserve/trim sweep, aj keeps canary at 10% until we verify 48h stability, i'll add evals and create a follow-up cadence.
samir: cc @eng-sre in case node-level allocator needs tuning (jemalloc arenas etc).
jess: noted — i'll add a ticket for allocator investigation if frag_ratio remains >0.2 after config changes.
mira: thanks all — keeping this thread for updates.
